title: What's your favorite food?
sentences: Oh pizza, that's cool! Why do you like it so much?
Because it's warm and cheesy, it just makes me happy!
That is nice! Have you always loved pizza?
Yes, ever since I was a little kid.
Wow, that's a long time! Do you remember the first time you ate pizza?
I don't remember the first time, but I know I liked it right away.
Nice! What other food do you like?
Oh yes, spaghetti is good too. And what do you like about that?
It's fun to twirl on my fork and I like the sauce. What do you actually like?
I like chicken nuggets and fries.
Yes, those are tasty too. And do you like to drink something with your food?
I like a coke with dinner.
I don't drink anything when I eat. Because it wouldn't be healthy.
Oh, would you mind telling me more about that?
That's allright, but another time. Now I'm going to cook something for you first.
Oh nice. Then I lie down on the couch for a moment.
